ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels in the central lobe areas and 30% low-intensity black pixels along the borders and central hinge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric fields on both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped to the leading edge, the central median notch area, and appears as asymmetric streaks and mottling across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-7 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased complexity near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoid-type curve characterized by an inner concave sweep from the notch transitioning to an outer convex sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast light-colored pixels (barnacle encrustation) on the distal tips of both lobes; a singular dark circular ring anomaly is present on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the ventral surface, with high density on the left lobe's central white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear rake marks across both lobes and heavy barnacle colonization on the outer distal points.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated circular ring-shaped scar located in the upper-mid section of the high-intensity field on the right lobe.
